translation.To modify a data item, specify a pre-act:
To modify a data item, specify a pre-activity expression for Start or Approval activity.

For a string, the value must be enclosed in single quote. Otherwise, it is treated as a macro.
For example, to prepend a dollar sign to a price, map the '$' + flowdata.get('cost') source expression to a target form field called Price.
translation.To create a new variable on the flowdata:
To create a new variable on the flowdata object, specify a post-activity target expression for the Start or Approval activity.

For example, on mapping the “reason” field to the target expression “flowdata.myReason”, a new data item “myReason” is available to all the activities executed later in the workflow.
